Each map covers 1 park, reservation, square, or plaza. Some maps also show buildings and underground utility lines. Title devised by cataloger. "To accompany annual report of Officer in Charge of Public Buildings and Grounds for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1886." Photocopies of ms. maps in the National Archives and Records Administration, Cartographic and Architectural Branch, record group 77. Some original maps include later annotations. On some originals: H Ex1 pt2 v2 49 2. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
